credits.changes: All usable SFZ mappings retained across 24 chromatic roots and five velocity zones; deterministic round-robin conversion; AAC-LC delivery and uniform group leveling. Delivery curated by objective defect, onset, headroom, DC, and within-layer level consistency metrics; at most two variants per tonal layer, four per snare velocity zone.
